end.summary:
Riya explained unity in diversity as different people, traditions and practices sharing a common society.
Riya gave examples involving Hindi and Punjabi songs, Pongal and Lohri, phiran and lungi, and regional foods.
Riya identified shared celebrations, cooperation and respect as ways diversity enriches society.
Riya’s final teach-back was not yet passed.
end.parentNote: Riya practised explaining how different languages, foods, clothing, festivals and music can exist together in one society. Riya first connected diversity with different song feelings, then clarified the idea using regional examples and shared values such as cooperation and respect. At home, ask Riya to compare two festivals or foods and name one difference and one shared value.
